_about: The classic HUD: a hash of every quad EmitHud produces, for each of the 128 levels at tick 420 and for the states that frame never reaches. Recorded by `test_mp test_mp_layer --record-golden` on the CLASSIC claim and HUD code as it stood at commit 3926faf (planning step 178, CTL-2), where the only production change is the two test seams ControlAt and PlaceCameraForTest, before the controls were refactored (CTL-3). EXTENDED ONCE, before CTL-3 began and on the same unmodified claim code, by the states a review found missing (a level younger than 700 ms with clear-portals shown, the pads mid-slide, the door tick): the entries recorded first (14 claim, 138 HUD) kept their values byte for byte. A golden is never re-recorded to make a refactor pass: if the classic path really changed on purpose, the step says so and records why. Hashes are FNV-1a over float bits and picture file names; no pixel and no Asantee byte is here.
